_note: Films and series for /culture/films-and-series: title, year, maker and our own short description, nothing else. No streaming links (they change). `level` is our estimate of how much Spanish you need to enjoy it with Spanish subtitles. Years and directors are from memory of well-documented works and are listed 'to verify' in the culture report. Added 2026-11-06.

items.title: La lengua de las mariposas
items.text: A shy boy in a Galician village and his old teacher, in the months before the Civil War. Quiet, clear speech, and an ending people remember.

items.title: Campeones
items.text: A basketball coach in trouble with the law has to train a team of players with intellectual disabilities. A warm comedy in everyday Spanish.

items.title: Ocho apellidos vascos
items.text: A man from Seville follows a woman to the Basque Country. The comedy plays with clichés about both regions, so you hear two very different accents.

items.title: Volver
items.text: Women of one family between Madrid and a village in La Mancha, with a secret that comes back. Fast, funny and sad at once.

items.title: Mujeres al borde de un ataque de nervios
items.text: A voice actress in Madrid tries to reach the man who left her, while her flat fills with people in trouble. A very fast comedy.

items.title: Mar adentro
items.text: Based on the life of Ramón Sampedro, a Galician man who fought for the right to end his life after an accident. Serious and calm.

items.title: El laberinto del fauno
items.text: Spain after the Civil War: a girl escapes from a cruel captain into a world of fantasy. A dark film with violent scenes, made by a Mexican director.

items.title: Aquí no hay quien viva
items.text: A comedy about the neighbours of one Madrid building and their meetings of the comunidad. Good for everyday, colloquial Spanish.

items.title: Cuéntame cómo pasó
items.text: One Madrid family from the late 1960s onwards. You follow recent Spanish history through their kitchen table.

items.title: La casa de papel
items.text: A group of thieves takes over the Spanish mint. Tense, fast and full of slang, so subtitles help.

items.title: Roma
items.text: Mexico: a year in the life of a domestic worker and the family she works for in Mexico City, in the early 1970s. Slow, in black and white, with some Mixtec.

items.title: Machuca
items.text: Chile, 1973: two boys from very different families become friends just before the coup. The Spanish of Chile can be fast, so take your time.

items.title: Diarios de motocicleta
items.text: Two young Argentines cross South America by motorbike in 1952; one of them is Ernesto Guevara. You hear several ways of speaking Spanish.

items.title: El secreto de sus ojos
items.text: Argentina: a retired court employee goes back to an old murder case. A good place to hear vos and the accent of Buenos Aires.

items.title: Relatos salvajes
items.text: Argentina: six short, darkly funny stories about people who lose their temper. Each one is short, so it suits one evening at a time.
